typography.heading_treatment: Nunito at bold (800) weight for H1 display headings at 48–72px with slightly tight tracking (−0.02em), sentence case throughout; H2 at semibold (700) 32–40px; H3 at semibold 22–26px — the rounded letterforms give every headline an approachable, huggable energy that matches the friendly consumer app aesthetic and the Lumi & Bloom brand voice without ever feeling childish

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Lumi & Bloom Home page is an image-led, gallery-first landing experience that leads with visual warmth and converts through emotional delight rather than clinical persuasion. The page is structured in five sections with deliberately varied skeletons — no two sections share the same compositional logic — creating a rhythm that alternates between dense visual energy and breathing room.

SECTION RHYTHM:
1. Hero — full-bleed warm color block with off-axis type and a large centered bloom illustration bleeding across the bottom edge into section 2. Asymmetric text alignment (left-anchored on desktop, centered on mobile).
2. Product Gallery — masonry-style 4-tile grid with sticker badges overlapping card edges, product imagery dominant, minimal copy. The gallery bleeds to near-full viewport width with only a thin gutter.
3. Stats — a horizontal marquee-style strip in Petal Mint, oversized Fredoka One numerals as visual anchors, very low body copy weight. Dense, fast to scan, zero padding waste.
4. Testimonials — alternating card layout with Glow Peach card backgrounds, off-axis customer name treatment, and a pull-quote typographic stunt where the opening quotation mark is rendered in Lumi Coral at ~120px Fredoka One, bleeding behind the card surface.
5. CTA Close — full-bleed Lumi Coral panel with the botanical leaf-sprig pattern asset tiled behind the text at low opacity, centered composition (appropriate for a terminal close), large display headline in Nunito 800, white CTAs.

SIGNATURE MOMENT — "The Bloom Bleed":
The hero section's illustrated bloom motif (a cheerful abstract radiating petal circle) is rendered at approximately 480px diameter, centered horizontally in the lower half of the hero panel, and it physically overlaps the bottom edge of the hero, bleeding 80–100px down into the product gallery section below. The gallery tiles beneath it shift slightly to accommodate the overlap via a top padding buffer. This creates a visual through-line that stitches the hero into the gallery — the brand's most important conversion zone — and makes the page feel like a single flowing composition rather than a stack of independent sections. This move is perfectly calibrated to the Friendly Consumer App aesthetic: it's playful, rounded, warm, and uses the illustrated icon vocabulary at full amplitude rather than tucking it into a corner. It also reinforces the brand name (Bloom) as a literal visual moment.

COLOR LOGIC:
- Section 1 (Hero): Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) warm background, Deep Petal (#2D3A35) headline text, Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) primary CTA, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) secondary CTA outline.
- Section 2 (Gallery): Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) background, product cards on white with Glow Peach highlight ribbon at top, Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) sticker badges, Lumi Coral "See Full Collection" CTA.
- Section 3 (Stats): Full-bleed Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) background, Deep Petal numerals in Fredoka One at 64–72px, Aqua Bloom used as the rule/divider between stat cells.
- Section 4 (Testimonials): Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9) section background, Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) individual card fills, Lumi Coral oversized quotation mark, Deep Petal body text.
- Section 5 (CTA): Full-bleed Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) background, white headline and subheadline, white-outlined secondary CTA button, botanical pattern at 12% opacity in Deep Petal.

TYPOGRAPHY HIERARCHY:
- H1 (Hero): Nunito 800, 64–72px desktop / 40px mobile, sentence case, tracking −0.02em, Deep Petal.
- H2 (Section headings): Nunito 700, 36–40px desktop / 28px mobile.
- Eyebrow labels: Fredoka One, 11–12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Lumi Coral or Aqua Bloom depending on section background.
- Body / descriptions: DM Sans 400, 16–17px, line-height 1.65, Deep Petal.
- Stat numerals: Fredoka One, 64–72px, Deep Petal.
- Product card titles: Nunito 700, 20px.
- Badge/sticker labels: Fredoka One, 11px, all-caps, 0.10em tracking, on Sunshine Butter or Petal Mint backgrounds.

DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC:
Hero is spacious (generous vertical padding, ~120px top/bottom desktop). Gallery is dense and visual-first with tight internal card gutters (12–16px). Stats strip is compact and horizontal — minimal vertical padding (~48px), relying on the large numerals to carry visual weight. Testimonials return to medium density with cards that breathe. CTA close is deliberately spare — centered text block, no competing elements, maximum breathing room around the headline.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:
- Hero: single-column centered on mobile, bloom illustration scales to 280px and sits below the text stack.
- Gallery: 2×2 grid on tablet, single column stacked on mobile with full-width cards.
- Stats: 2×2 grid on tablet/mobile instead of horizontal strip; numerals scale to 48px.
- Testimonials: horizontal scroll on mobile (cards at ~80vw), 3-column on desktop.
- CTA: single column centered on all breakpoints; pattern tile scales naturally.

SHARED DESIGN SYSTEM FIT:
All fonts (Nunito, DM Sans, Fredoka One), all color tokens, rounded card corners (16–20px radius), illustrated icon fills, and friendly CTA copy are drawn directly from the shared design system. The Home page is the most visually expressive page in the site — it uses the widest range of palette tokens and the most assertive typographic moves — establishing the brand energy that the other four pages will reference and modulate.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
HERO SECTION — Full-bleed Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) background panel. Eyebrow: Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E), positioned 8px above the headline. Text reads 'Clean Body Care, Made for You'.

Headline: Nunito 800, 68px desktop / 40px mobile, sentence case, tracking −0.02em, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), line-height 1.1. Text reads 'Your Daily Glow Starts Here'. Allow the headline to span two lines naturally on desktop.

Subheadline: DM Sans 400, 18px, line-height 1.65, Deep Petal at 80% opacity, max-width 480px, 20px top margin from headline. Text reads 'Nourishing body care crafted from clean ingredients — because feeling good in your skin should be the easiest part of your day.'

CTA row: 32px top margin. Primary CTA 'Shop All Products' — Nunito 700, 16px, Lumi Coral background (#FF6F5E), white text, 48px height, 24px horizontal padding, 24px border-radius (pill shape). Secondary CTA 'Our Story' — Nunito 700, 16px, transparent background, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) border 2px, Aqua Bloom text, same pill dimensions. 12px gap between buttons. Buttons left-aligned on desktop, stacked full-width centered on mobile.

Section padding: 100px top, 40px bottom on desktop (reduced bottom because the bloom illustration provides the visual close). 64px top, 32px bottom on mobile.

Background: solid Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) fill — no gradient, no texture. The warmth of the flat color is intentional and reinforces the 'skin-toned' softness described in the design system. The bloom illustration's own colors (soft coral petals, warm white glow center, mint leaf accents) provide all the visual complexity needed against this background.

PRODUCT GALLERY SECTION — Background: Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4). The section begins with a ~80–100px top padding buffer that accommodates the bloom illustration bleeding down from the hero above — this buffer is the visual 'landing zone' for the overlap and should not be filled with any competing element.

Eyebrow: Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0), centered horizontally. Text reads 'Our Bestsellers'.

Headline: Nunito 700, 38px desktop / 26px mobile, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), centered, max-width 600px, auto horizontal margin. Text reads 'Products People Can't Stop Reaching For'. 8px below eyebrow.

- Below the image: 16px padding on all sides. Product title in Nunito 700, 20px, Deep Petal. Size metadata in Fredoka One, 11px, all-caps, Aqua Bloom, 4px below title. Description in DM Sans 400, 15px, Deep Petal at 75% opacity, 8px below size, 3-line max with ellipsis.
- No per-card CTA button — the gallery is browse-first.

Section CTA: 'See Full Collection' — Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) background, white Nunito 700 16px text, pill shape (24px radius), 48px height, 32px horizontal padding. Centered below the grid, 40px top margin.

Section bottom padding: 80px desktop, 48px mobile.

STATS SECTION — Full-bleed Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) background panel. This section functions as a compact horizontal marquee-style trust strip — low vertical footprint, high visual punch. No image assets. Padding: 56px top and bottom on desktop, 40px on mobile.

Eyebrow: Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Deep Petal (#2D3A35) at 60% opacity, centered. Text reads 'Why Lumi & Bloom'. 0px bottom margin — the headline follows immediately.

Headline: Nunito 700, 34px desktop / 24px mobile, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), centered, 0px top margin from eyebrow, 40px bottom margin to stat row. Text reads 'Numbers That Speak for Themselves'.

Stat row: 4 stat cells arranged in a single horizontal row on desktop (each cell 3 columns wide in a 12-column grid). On tablet: 2×2 grid. On mobile: 2×2 grid with reduced numeral size.

- Vertical stack: numeral → description, center-aligned.

Stat content:
- Cell 1: '50,000+' / 'Happy customers who've made Lumi & Bloom part of their daily ritual.'
- Cell 2: '100% Clean' / 'Every formula is free from parabens, sulfates, and synthetic dyes.'
- Cell 3: '12 Products' / 'A tight, intentional range — each one developed for a specific skin need.'
- Cell 4: '4.9 ★ Average' / 'Rated by real customers across our full product catalog.' — The star character renders in Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) within the Fredoka One numeral string.

No CTA in this section. The section's job is pure credibility delivery — let the numbers breathe.

TESTIMONIALS SECTION — Background: Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9). This section uses a typographic stunt as its local signature move: a single oversized opening quotation mark in Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) at 120px Fredoka One sits behind the first testimonial card, bleeding upward out of the card's top-left corner by approximately 40px, partially overlapping the section background. This is a deliberate off-axis ornamental anchor that gives the section a magazine-editorial feel while staying within the Friendly Consumer App's playful vocabulary.

Eyebrow: Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E), left-aligned at the section's content column left edge (columns 1–10 of 12). Text reads 'Real People, Real Glow'.

Headline: Nunito 700, 38px desktop / 26px mobile, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), left-aligned (NOT centered — resist symmetry here), max-width 520px, 8px below eyebrow. Text reads 'The Community Has Spoken'. 32px bottom margin to card row.

Testimonial cards: 3 cards in a horizontal row on desktop (each 4 columns wide, 16px gutter). On mobile: horizontal scroll container, each card 80vw wide, 16px gap, with a visible partial peek of the next card to signal scrollability.

Each card:
- Background: Glow Peach (#FFCBA4). Border-radius: 20px. Padding: 28px. No drop shadow — the warm color block is sufficient to lift the card off the Soft Cloud background.
- Inside the card, top-left: a small Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) quotation mark in Fredoka One at 32px, acting as a mini version of the oversized background quote mark — creating a visual rhyme between the background ornament and the card interior.
- Quote body: DM Sans 400, 16px, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), line-height 1.65, italic style. Full quote text as provided.
- Reviewer name: Nunito 800, 17px, Deep Petal, 16px top margin. Left-aligned.
- Product tag: Fredoka One, 11px, all-caps, 0.08em tracking, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0), on a white pill background (border-radius 20px, 4px vertical / 10px horizontal padding), 8px below name. Text: product name as provided in metadata.

The oversized background quotation mark (120px Fredoka One, Lumi Coral, position: absolute, top: −20px, left: 0px relative to the card row container, z-index behind all cards) is placed once for the entire section — it is NOT repeated per card. It anchors the left side of the card row and creates an asymmetric visual weight that pulls the eye left before scanning right through the cards.

Section padding: 80px top, 80px bottom on desktop. 56px top, 48px bottom on mobile.

CTA CLOSE SECTION — Full-bleed Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) background panel. This is the most saturated, energetically committed panel on the page — a deliberate color-block break from the warm neutrals and pastels above. It uses the botanical leaf-sprig pattern asset tiled across the entire background at 10–12% opacity in Deep Petal (#2D3A35), giving the flat coral surface a subtle organic texture that reinforces the clean, natural brand aesthetic without competing with the white headline text. The pattern is positioned behind all text and button elements (z-index: 0).

Layout: single centered column, max-width 600px, horizontally and vertically centered within the panel. This is one of the two places in the page where centered composition is intentional — a terminal close panel is a heritage move that the Friendly Consumer App aesthetic supports for conversion moments.

Eyebrow: Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.12em, white at 80% opacity, centered. Text reads 'Join the Glow'. 0px bottom margin.

Headline: Nunito 800, 64px desktop / 40px mobile, white (#FFFFFF), centered, tracking −0.02em, line-height 1.05, 8px top margin from eyebrow. Text reads 'Ready to Start Your Ritual?' — the question mark is rendered in Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) as a single-character color accent within the white headline string, adding a playful wink consistent with the brand voice.

Subheadline: DM Sans 400, 17px, white at 85% opacity, centered, max-width 400px, line-height 1.6, 20px top margin from headline. Text reads 'Free shipping on orders over $45. Clean ingredients. Real results.'

CTA row: 32px top margin, centered, horizontal layout on desktop / stacked on mobile with 12px gap.
- Primary CTA 'Shop Now': white background, Lumi Coral text (#FF6F5E), Nunito 700, 16px, pill shape (24px radius), 48px height, 32px horizontal padding. On hover: Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) background, Deep Petal text — a warm surprise that rewards engagement.
- Secondary CTA 'Learn Our Story': white border 2px, white text, transparent background, same pill dimensions. On hover: white background at 15% opacity fill.

Section padding: 96px top and bottom on desktop, 72px top and bottom on mobile. The generous padding isolates this panel as a deliberate breathing space and makes the coral feel like a bold statement rather than a cramped footer.

The botanical pattern asset placement: tiled seamlessly across the entire panel background, pattern scale at approximately 120px repeat unit, opacity 12%, Deep Petal color. The low opacity ensures the pattern reads as texture rather than illustration, keeping the CTA message dominant.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
## Our Brand Page — Full Design Direction

### Page Identity & Goal
This is an editorial brand story page for Lumi & Bloom, a friendly body care brand. The goal is emotional connection — not conversion pressure. Every section should feel like turning a page in a beautifully illustrated brand journal: warm, personal, visually joyful, and honest. The page must feel distinctly different from the product catalog (gallery-heavy) and the home page (high-energy landing). Here, the rhythm slows and deepens.

### Signature Moment
**The Oversized Stacked Display Quote in Section 2 (Story Block).** The founding body copy is introduced by a massive, Fredoka One display pull-quote — "Made with two hands and a whole lot of belief." — rendered at 72–80px in Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E), spanning the full content column width, bleeding slightly off the left grid edge by ~24px. This is not a headline — it is a typographic stunt that transforms the story block into a type-as-image moment. The oversized Fredoka One letterforms (rounded, playful, warm) are the visual_cue of "illustrated icons" and "friendly CTAs" expressed at display scale. The color-saturated coral on Bloom Milk background creates the high-energy accent moment the aesthetic demands — accent color doing real structural work, not just sitting on a button. The pull-quote sits above the narrative body copy, anchoring the section as the page's most memorable, scroll-stopping beat.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Page Header** — Centered editorial masthead with illustration floating above headline. Sparse, airy, sets a personal tone. Bloom Milk background.
2. **Story Block** — Signature moment lives here. Asymmetric two-column split: oversized display pull-quote left, narrative body text right on desktop. Dense typographic energy. Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) warm background block.
3. **Feature Grid (Values)** — Four rounded cards in a 2×2 grid on Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) background. Illustrated icons. Friendly, scannable. Medium density.
4. **Timeline** — Vertical side-tabbed alternating layout. Milestone icons left, text right, with Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) milestone markers. Off-axis, asymmetric. Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9) background.
5. **CTA Close** — Full-bleed Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) panel. Centered composition (intentional — this is the warmth-closing beat). Large Nunito display headline in Deep Petal reversed to white. Two CTA buttons: primary white-fill, secondary ghost/outline.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Section 1: Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) — warm, welcoming entry
- Section 2: Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) — warmth amplified for the founding story; the signature pull-quote in Lumi Coral pops against this
- Section 3: Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) — freshness and clean values signal
- Section 4: Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9) — calm, credibility-building timeline
- Section 5: Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) full-bleed — energetic, warm close
No two adjacent sections share the same background. The page moves: warm → warmer → fresh → cool → hot. This arc mirrors the emotional journey: welcome → personal story → values → credibility → action.

### Typography Hierarchy
- Eyebrow labels: Fredoka One, 11–12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) on light backgrounds, Deep Petal (#2D3A35) on colored backgrounds
- H1 (Section 1): Nunito 800, 56–64px, −0.02em tracking, Deep Petal, sentence case
- Signature pull-quote (Section 2): Fredoka One, 72–80px, Lumi Coral, left-bleeding
- H2 (Sections 3–5): Nunito 700, 34–40px, Deep Petal or white depending on background
- Body copy: DM Sans 400, 17px, 1.65 line-height, Deep Petal
- Card titles (Section 3): Nunito 700, 20px
- Timeline titles (Section 4): Nunito 700, 18px, Deep Petal; years in Fredoka One 22px, Sunshine Butter background badge

### Density & Whitespace Logic
- Sections 1 and 5 are sparse — generous vertical padding (96px top/bottom), minimal elements, breathing room
- Section 2 is intentionally dense with the display type — the pull-quote creates visual weight; body copy is offset to the right, creating productive tension
- Section 3 is medium density — 2×2 grid with comfortable card padding (32px internal), icons at top of each card
- Section 4 alternates dense (milestone text) with sparse (icon column) — the side-by-side rhythm creates a scanning cadence
- Overall page vertical padding rhythm: 80–96px between sections, 48px within section internal elements

### Responsive Behavior
- Desktop (≥1024px): All multi-column layouts render as described (2-col story, 2×2 grid, side-tab timeline)
- Tablet (768–1023px): Story block stacks pull-quote above body copy (both full width); values grid becomes 2×2 with reduced card padding; timeline remains side-by-side but tighter
- Mobile (<768px): Story block stacks vertically, pull-quote scales to 48px; values grid becomes 1-column stack; timeline becomes full-width vertical list with icon badges inline above text; all section padding reduces to 48px top/bottom

### Shared Design System Fit
This page uses all eight palette colors across its five sections, demonstrating the full system range. Nunito, DM Sans, and Fredoka One all appear. The rounded card visual_cue appears in Section 3, illustrated icons in Sections 3 and 4, and the soft color blocks in Sections 1–4. The page is unmistakably Lumi & Bloom — warm, human, playful — while being distinctly editorial rather than transactional.

**Section 2 — Story Block (brand-section-2) — SIGNATURE MOMENT SECTION**

This section contains the page's signature typographic moment: an oversized Fredoka One display pull-quote rendered at 76px in Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E), bleeding ~24px off the left content-column edge. This is not a headline from the content spec — it is a designed editorial interpolation that captures the founding spirit expressed in the body copy. Tablet: Stack left column above right column, both full width. Pull-quote scales to 56px.
Mobile: Pull-quote scales to 44px, left-aligned with standard content margin (no bleed on mobile). Body copy below at full width.

This section has no CTA and no asset — the typography IS the visual. The Lumi Coral pull-quote on Glow Peach is a warm, high-contrast moment that feels inevitable for a friendly consumer app aesthetic: bold, rounded, human, and joyful rather than aggressive.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
**Products Page — Visual Design Plan**

**Page Role & Tone**
This is the primary catalog page for Lumi & Bloom — a gallery-first, visually immersive product listing that must feel like browsing a beautifully curated beauty edit, not scanning a data table. The friendly consumer app aesthetic runs at full amplitude: rounded cards, illustrated badge icons, soft color blocks, and large readable type throughout. Every section has a distinct skeleton so the page breathes and surprises rather than repeating a template.

**Signature Moment — "Find Your New Ritual" Full-Bleed Gallery Mosaic with Oversized Floating Type**
Located in Section 2 (the product gallery), the signature moment is a masonry-style full-bleed image grid where the headline "Find Your New Ritual" is rendered in Fredoka One at 96–112px in Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) and floats at 40% opacity across the top-left of the gallery grid, bleeding off the left edge of the viewport. The product cards sit beneath and partially overlap this oversized display type, creating a type-as-texture layer that is unmistakably "friendly consumer app" — playful, bold, and human without being childish. This move is grounded in the gallery_first layout family's full-bleed visual dominance and the aesthetic's illustrated, rounded, bright energy. It is the loudest moment on the page and anchors the entire composition.

**Section Sequence & Rhythm**
1. Page Header — masthead-style, left-aligned, sparse, Soft Cloud background. Sets expectation without overwhelming.
2. Product Gallery — full-bleed, maximum visual density, Bloom Milk background with floating oversized type. The page's dominant section and signature moment.
3. Comparison — structured table/card hybrid on Petal Mint background. Dense but scannable; a deliberate rhythm break from the gallery's visual noise.
4. Feature Grid — Sunshine Butter background, icon-forward, badge-style layout. Playful and credible simultaneously.
5. CTA Close — Deep Petal full-bleed dark panel, centered, high contrast. The one symmetric composition on the page — earned by being the terminal block.

**Color & Surface Logic**
- Section 1: Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9) — cool, airy opener
- Section 2: Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) — warm, product-photography-friendly base; Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) for the floating oversized headline
- Section 3: Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) — freshness signal, alternating panel
- Section 4: Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) — playful badge energy, formulation claims
- Section 5: Deep Petal (#2D3A35) — dark terminal anchor, Bloom Milk and Lumi Coral text/buttons

Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) is used as the secondary interactive color on comparison table headers and card accent borders in Section 3. Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) is used as the tile highlight ribbon on product cards in Section 2. Sunshine Butter badge labels appear on product cards ("Bestseller", "New") in Section 2.

**Typographic Hierarchy**
- H1 display (Section 1 headline): Nunito 800, 56px, Deep Petal, −0.02em tracking, sentence case
- Floating gallery type (Section 2 signature): Fredoka One, 96–112px, Lumi Coral at 40% opacity, all-caps
- H2 section headlines: Nunito 700, 36–40px, Deep Petal or Bloom Milk depending on background
- Eyebrow labels: Fredoka One, 12px, 0.10em letter-spacing, all-caps, in Aqua Bloom or Lumi Coral
- Product card titles: Nunito 700, 18–20px
- Body / description text: DM Sans 400, 16px, 1.65 line-height
- Comparison table headers: Nunito 700, 16px, Deep Petal on Aqua Bloom tinted header row
- Badge/sticker labels: Fredoka One, 11px, 0.12em, all-caps, Sunshine Butter background or Lumi Coral background

**Density & Whitespace Logic**
Sections alternate between high density (gallery, comparison table) and deliberate breathing room (page header, CTA close). The feature grid sits at medium density — four items with generous icon space. No two consecutive sections share the same density level or background color.

**Responsive Behavior**
- Section 2 gallery: 4-column masonry on desktop → 2-column on tablet → single-column scroll on mobile. The floating oversized type scales down to 56px on mobile and shifts to top-center alignment.
- Section 3 comparison: 4-column card row on desktop → 2×2 grid on tablet → stacked single column on mobile.
- Section 4 feature grid: 4 columns desktop → 2×2 tablet → 2×2 mobile (icons large enough to remain legible).
- Section 5 CTA: centered single column on all breakpoints.
- All rounded card radii (20–24px) are preserved across breakpoints.

**Shared Design System Fit**
Nunito headings, DM Sans body, and Fredoka One accents are applied consistently. All eight palette colors appear somewhere on this page, with no color used only once. The rounded card language, illustrated badge icons, and friendly CTA button style (Lumi Coral, rounded pill, DM Sans 500 16px) are maintained throughout.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Sustainability page for Lumi & Bloom must read as a confident, honest editorial — not a greenwashing brochure. It earns trust through visual specificity: oversized numbers, a public roadmap, and a color system that does real structural work rather than dressing up identical card rows.

SECTION SEQUENCE AND RHYTHM:
1. Page Header — full-bleed Petal Mint panel, illustration centered and large, headline in a dramatic display weight. Dense, immersive opener.
2. Stats — Bloom Milk surface, oversized numerals as the visual lead, progress-bar chart anchored left with copy right. Data-forward, airy.
3. Feature Grid — Soft Cloud background, four asymmetric pillar cards with illustrated icon fills in Sunshine Butter and Aqua Bloom. Medium density.
4. Timeline — Deep Petal full-bleed dark panel, alternating left/right milestone entries with status badges. Dense, high-contrast, editorial.
5. CTA Close — Lumi Coral full-bleed block, large centered display type, two buttons. Energetic, sparse, conclusive.

The rhythm deliberately alternates: immersive opener → data-sparse airy → medium-grid → dense dark → saturated energetic close. No two consecutive sections share the same background color or layout skeleton.

SIGNATURE MOMENT:
The page's signature moment lives in Section 4 (Timeline). The entire section is a full-bleed Deep Petal (#2D3A35) panel — a dramatic botanical-dark slab that breaks the warm pastel axis of the rest of the page. Inside it, the milestone years (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2026) are rendered in Fredoka One at 72–80px in Sunshine Butter (#FFE566), functioning as oversized display anchors rather than mere labels. Each year bleeds slightly into the gutter, creating an off-grid, sticker-on-a-journal energy that is unmistakably friendly-consumer-app while being structurally bold. Status badges ("Complete," "In Progress," "Planned") are rounded pill shapes in Petal Mint, Aqua Bloom, and Glow Peach respectively, reinforcing the illustrated-icon visual language. This move is calibrated to the aesthetic: it's not brutalist loud, it's playful-bold — a scrapbook timeline on a dark botanical ground.

COLOR AND SURFACE USAGE:
- Section 1: Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) full-bleed background — signals freshness immediately.
- Section 2: Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) — warm neutral, lets the Lumi Coral and Aqua Bloom stat numerals breathe.
- Section 3: Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9) — subtle contrast shift from Bloom Milk, keeps the grid legible.
- Section 4: Deep Petal (#2D3A35) — the dark break, maximum contrast, anchors the page's emotional center of gravity.
- Section 5: Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) — brand's most energetic tone closes with action energy.
Accent colors (Lumi Coral, Aqua Bloom, Sunshine Butter) appear in oversized type, badge fills, progress bars, and icon backgrounds — never only on CTAs.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY:
- Nunito 800 at 56–72px for H1 display in Section 1; 40–48px H2 in Sections 2 and 4; 32px H2 in Sections 3 and 5.
- Fredoka One all-caps 11–13px wide-tracked eyebrow labels throughout; also deployed at 72–80px for timeline year anchors (Section 4's signature move).
- DM Sans 16–18px body at 1.65 line-height for descriptions, stat captions, and timeline milestone copy.
- Stat numerals in Section 2 use Nunito 800 at 64–72px in Lumi Coral and Aqua Bloom — type as visual object, not just information.

DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC:
Sections 1 and 5 are deliberately sparse — large type, generous padding (80–100px vertical), minimal copy — to bookend the page with breathing room. Sections 2 and 3 are medium density with 48–64px section padding. Section 4 is the densest, with tighter 32px internal row gaps to create the feeling of a packed, honest accountability log.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:
- Section 1: illustration scales down to 60vw on mobile, headline drops to 36px.
- Section 2: stat numerals stack 2×2 on tablet, single column on mobile; chart becomes full-width.
- Section 3: four-column grid collapses to 2×2 on tablet, single column on mobile.
- Section 4: timeline alternating left/right collapses to a single left-aligned column on mobile; year anchors reduce to 48px.
- Section 5: CTA buttons stack vertically on mobile with full width.

PAGE FIT IN SHARED DESIGN SYSTEM:
All fonts (Nunito, DM Sans, Fredoka One), all color tokens, and all component shapes (rounded cards, pill badges, illustrated icon fills) are sourced directly from the shared design system. This page distinguishes itself within the site through its dark Deep Petal panel (used nowhere else at full-bleed) and the oversized Fredoka One year anchors, which are a page-exclusive typographic stunt grounded in the accent_treatment spec.

SECTION TYPE: stats. BACKGROUND: Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) — warm neutral that makes the stat numerals and chart pop. LAYOUT: Two-zone asymmetric split on desktop. Left zone: 55% width, contains the four stat items arranged in a 2×2 grid of oversized-numeral stat cards. Right zone: 45% width, contains the progress-bar chart asset plus eyebrow and headline stacked above it. On tablet: single column, chart above stats. On mobile: single column, chart then stats. EYEBROW (right zone, top): 'Our Impact So Far' in Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0), left-aligned within the right zone. HEADLINE (right zone): 'Progress We Can Actually Measure' in Nunito 700, 36px, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), left-aligned, tracking −0.02em, 8px below eyebrow. CHART ASSET: The horizontal progress-bar chart sits immediately below the headline in the right zone, full width of the right column. Bar fills use: Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) for the 78% recycled materials bar, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) for the 100% carbon-offset bar, and Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) for the 2026 plastic-free goal tracker (shown as a partially filled future bar with a dashed right edge to signal 'in progress'). Bar labels are DM Sans 14px, Deep Petal. Bar backgrounds are Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9) rounded pill tracks. Chart sits 24px below headline. STAT CARDS (left zone, 2×2 grid, 16px gap): Each card is a rounded-corner (20px radius) surface in Bloom Milk with a 1.5px Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) border. Inside each card: the stat value (e.g., '78%', 'Carbon Neutral', '2026', '1% for the Planet') in Nunito 800, 56px on desktop / 40px on tablet, alternating between Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) and Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) across the four cards (Coral, Aqua, Coral, Aqua). Below the value: the description in DM Sans 400, 15px, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), line-height 1.6, max 3 lines. Card internal padding: 24px. The oversized stat numerals function as type-as-image moments — they are the visual lead of the left zone, not supporting elements. SECTION SPACING: 72px top and bottom padding. LEFT/RIGHT ZONE gap: 48px.

SECTION TYPE: feature_grid. BACKGROUND: Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9) — a subtle blue-white shift from Bloom Milk that provides section separation without a hard color break, keeping the page feeling continuous and airy. LAYOUT: Full-width section, max-content-width 1200px, centered. Eyebrow and headline are left-aligned above the grid, not centered, to resist symmetry. Grid: 4 columns on desktop, 2×2 on tablet, 1 column on mobile, 24px column gap, 24px row gap. EYEBROW: 'Our Four Pillars' in Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0), left-aligned, 0px indent. HEADLINE: 'How We Think About Doing Better' in Nunito 700, 38px, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), left-aligned, 8px below eyebrow, tracking −0.02em. SUBHEADLINE: 'Every sustainability decision at Lumi & Bloom runs through these four lenses.' in DM Sans 400, 17px, Deep Petal (#2D3A35) at 75% opacity, left-aligned, max-width 520px, 12px below headline. Grid starts 40px below subheadline. PILLAR CARDS: Each card is a rounded-corner (24px radius) white (Bloom Milk #FFF8F4) surface with a soft drop shadow (0 4px 16px rgba(45,58,53,0.08)). Card internal padding: 28px. Each card has a square illustrated icon at top-left (48×48px), with icon background fills cycling through: Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) for Pillar 1, Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) for Pillar 2, Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) for Pillar 3, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) for Pillar 4. Icon backgrounds are rounded squares (12px radius). Icon strokes use Deep Petal (#2D3A35). CARD TITLE: Pillar name (e.g., 'Clean Formulation') in Nunito 700, 20px, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), 16px below icon. CARD DESCRIPTION: DM Sans 400, 15px, Deep Petal (#2D3A35) at 80% opacity, line-height 1.65, 8px below title. Cards have no CTA links — the pillar descriptions are self-contained. SECTION SPACING: 72px top and bottom padding. The four distinct icon background colors across the grid give the section a playful, illustrated-icon energy without requiring actual custom illustrations in every card.

SECTION TYPE: timeline. SIGNATURE MOMENT OF THE PAGE. BACKGROUND: Full-bleed Deep Petal (#2D3A35) — the only dark panel on the entire page, creating a dramatic tonal break that anchors the page's emotional center of gravity. This is the page's signature moment. LAYOUT: Full viewport width, max-content-width 960px centered. The timeline is a vertical spine: a 2px Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) vertical line runs down the center of the content column on desktop. Milestone entries alternate left/right of the spine (odd entries left-aligned with content to the left of the spine, even entries right-aligned with content to the right). On mobile/tablet the spine moves to the left edge and all entries are left-aligned. EYEBROW: 'The Roadmap' in Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Petal Mint (#A8E6CF), centered above the timeline, 0px below section top padding. HEADLINE: 'Where We've Been and Where We're Going' in Nunito 800, 44px on desktop / 32px on mobile, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4), centered, tracking −0.02em, 10px below eyebrow. SUBHEADLINE: 'We share this publicly because accountability is part of the commitment.' in DM Sans 400, 17px, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) at 70% opacity, centered, max-width 500px, 16px below headline. Timeline starts 48px below subheadline. MILESTONE ENTRIES: Each entry has three elements: (1) YEAR ANCHOR — the year portion of the title (e.g., '2021') in Fredoka One, 72px on desktop / 48px on mobile, Sunshine Butter (#FFE566), positioned so it overlaps slightly into the spine gutter, creating an off-grid sticker-on-journal effect. (2) MILESTONE TITLE — the event label (e.g., 'Recycled Packaging Introduced') in Nunito 700, 20px, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4), 8px below the year anchor. (3) DESCRIPTION — DM Sans 400, 15px, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) at 75% opacity, line-height 1.65, max-width 340px per entry side. (4) STATUS BADGE — a rounded pill (40px height, 16px horizontal padding) positioned 12px below description: 'Complete' entries get Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) background with Deep Petal text; 'In Progress' entries get Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) background with Deep Petal text; 'Planned' entries get Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) background with Deep Petal text. Badge label in Fredoka One 11px all-caps letter-spacing 0.08em. SPINE CONNECTOR: A filled circle (12px diameter) in Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) sits on the spine at the vertical midpoint of each entry's year anchor, connecting the entry to the timeline. Vertical gap between entries: 48px on desktop, 32px on mobile. SECTION SPACING: 80px top and bottom padding.

SECTION TYPE: cta. BACKGROUND: Full-bleed Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) — the brand's most energetic, action-driving tone, used at full saturation for the entire section surface. This is the conclusive energy close of the page. LAYOUT: Single centered column, max-width 640px, horizontally centered. All elements centered. No illustration or asset — the coral color block is the visual event. EYEBROW: 'Join the Movement' in Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.10em, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) at 90% opacity, centered. HEADLINE: 'Every Purchase Is a Vote for Better Beauty' in Nunito 800, 52px on desktop / 36px on mobile, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4), centered, tracking −0.02em, sentence case, 12px below eyebrow. The word 'Vote' is set in Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) as a single-word color accent — a playful typographic stunt that reinforces the action-driving energy without adding a new element. SUBHEADLINE: 'When you choose Lumi & Bloom, you're choosing cleaner formulas, less plastic, and a brand that's trying to do right by the planet.' in DM Sans 400, 17px, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) at 80% opacity, centered, line-height 1.65, max-width 520px, 16px below headline. CTA BUTTONS: Two buttons, side-by-side on desktop (16px gap), stacked on mobile. Primary CTA 'Shop Clean': rounded pill button (48px height, 32px horizontal padding), Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) background, Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) text in Nunito 700 16px — the inverted coral-on-white creates a crisp contrast against the coral background. Secondary CTA 'Talk to Us': rounded pill button same size, transparent background, 2px solid Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) border, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) text in Nunito 700 16px. Both buttons have 0px border-radius override — they use the full pill shape (border-radius 9999px) consistent with the friendly consumer app visual cue of rounded cards and friendly CTAs. Buttons sit 32px below subheadline. SECTION SPACING: 88px top and bottom padding. The starkness of the coral block with only typography and two buttons creates deliberate sparse contrast after the dense Dark Petal timeline above — the page ends on an open, inviting exhale.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Contact page for Lumi & Bloom is a warm, gallery-forward composition that prioritizes human connection over corporate efficiency. It opens with a full-bleed, illustrated header that sets an inviting tone, moves through a two-column contact block with expressive color use, transitions into a side-tabbed FAQ panel with dense rhythm, opens into a bright social-channel feature grid, and closes with a bold Lumi Coral full-bleed CTA panel. The page alternates between warm-surface sections (Bloom Milk #FFF8F4, Soft Cloud #EDF6F9, Petal Mint #A8E6CF) and one high-energy Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) terminal panel, creating a clear density arc: open → structured → dense → airy → punchy.

SIGNATURE MOMENT — Section 1 (Page Header): The headline "We're Real People and We Actually Read These" is set in Nunito 800 at 64–72px, left-aligned, spanning roughly 65% of the viewport width, with the word "Real" rendered in Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) while the rest of the headline stays Deep Petal (#2D3A35). The open-envelope illustration floats at large scale (roughly 280px tall) off the right edge of the text block, partially cropped by the viewport edge, so its bloom flower spills into the header background. This asymmetric, oversized type-plus-illustration composition is the page's defining moment — it is unmistakably friendly-consumer-app in energy (rounded type, illustrated icon at hero scale, soft warm background) without being a standard split-hero template. The illustration is not tucked into a corner; it commands the right half of the header as a co-equal visual element.

SECTION RHYTHM VARIATION:
1. Page Header — asymmetric masthead with oversized type and large off-edge illustration; Glow Peach warm tint overlay on Bloom Milk background; left-aligned text block, illustration bleeds right.
2. Contact Block — asymmetric two-column layout: left column holds the form (60% width), right column holds the three direct email contacts stacked as bold, card-style rows with Petal Mint left-border accents; Soft Cloud background; dense but spacious.
3. FAQ — side-tabbed/accordion layout on Soft Cloud background with Petal Mint section band; question labels in Nunito semibold, answers in DM Sans; left-column category label as a large rotated Fredoka One eyebrow acting as a structural typographic accent.
4. Feature Grid (Stay Connected) — four cards in a 2×2 grid on a Petal Mint background block, each card on Bloom Milk with illustrated icon at top, Deep Petal text, and Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) icon strokes; airy, gallery-like spacing.
5. CTA Close — full-bleed Lumi Coral panel, centered composition (justified for this aesthetic as a terminal close move), Nunito 800 headline in Bloom Milk at 56px, two buttons (Bloom Milk primary, Aqua Bloom secondary outline), Sunshine Butter sticker badge accent.

TYPOGRAPHY HIERARCHY: H1 display (Nunito 800, 64–72px, −0.02em tracking) in Section 1 only. H2 section headlines (Nunito 700, 36–40px) in Sections 2–4. H3 item labels (Nunito 600, 22–24px). Body copy (DM Sans 400, 16–18px, 1.65 line-height). Eyebrow labels (Fredoka One, 12px, 0.10em letter-spacing, all-caps) throughout. Accent color (Lumi Coral) used on the hero word, FAQ question hover states, and the CTA panel background — not only on buttons.

COLOR DISTRIBUTION: Bloom Milk is the base surface. Glow Peach tints the header. Soft Cloud separates the contact block. Petal Mint owns the FAQ band and feature grid background. Lumi Coral is the hero word accent AND the full terminal panel. Aqua Bloom appears on secondary interactive elements and icon strokes. Sunshine Butter appears as a sticker label in the CTA close. Deep Petal anchors all body text and headings on light surfaces.

DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC: Section 1 is open and generous (96px vertical padding). Section 2 is structured and moderately dense (72px padding, tight card rows). Section 3 is the densest section (60px padding, five accordion items). Section 4 breathes again (80px padding, 2×2 grid with generous card padding). Section 5 is tight and punchy (80px padding, centered, minimal elements).

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On mobile, the Section 1 illustration moves below the headline block (stacked, not cropped). Section 2 stacks form above the email contact cards. Section 3 accordion collapses to full-width single-column. Section 4 grid collapses to 1×4 single column. Section 5 stacks CTAs vertically. All type scales down proportionally (H1 to 44px on mobile, H2 to 28px). Rounded card corners (16–24px radius) and soft color blocks are preserved at all breakpoints.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt: PAGE HEADER — 'Say Hello' / 'We're Real People and We Actually Read These'. Background: Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) with a soft Glow Peach (#FFCBA4) radial wash starting from the top-right corner and fading to transparent by 55% of the section width, giving the header a warm, skin-toned glow that feels inviting rather than clinical. Vertical padding: 96px top, 80px bottom. Layout: asymmetric, 12-column grid. Left text block occupies columns 1–7 (left-aligned, no centering). Right side (columns 8–12) is dominated by the open-envelope illustration. EYEBROW: Fredoka One, 12px, 0.10em letter-spacing, all-caps, Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E), sitting 20px above the headline. HEADLINE (SIGNATURE MOMENT): Nunito 800, 68px, −0.02em tracking, sentence case, two lines max. The word 'Real' in the headline is set in Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E); all other words remain Deep Petal (#2D3A35). This single-word color break is the page's defining typographic moment — it is not a gradient or a highlight box, just a clean, confident color swap that makes the brand's human promise visually literal. SUBHEADLINE: DM Sans 400, 18px, 1.65 line-height, Deep Petal at 70% opacity, set below the headline with 24px gap, max-width 520px. ILLUSTRATION PLACEMENT: The open-envelope SVG illustration (envelope with bloom flower emerging) is placed in columns 8–13, vertically centered to the text block, at approximately 300px tall. It is intentionally oversized relative to the column space and its right edge is allowed to bleed 40px beyond the viewport boundary on desktop — the bloom flower at the top of the envelope extends upward into the Glow Peach wash area. This off-edge placement signals the brand's playful, approachable energy and reinforces that the illustration is a co-equal compositional element, not a decorative footnote. No CTA buttons in this section. Bottom edge: a very subtle 2px Glow Peach horizontal rule separates this section from the next. On mobile (< 768px): illustration moves below the headline/subheadline stack, centered, at 200px tall, no bleed crop.

CONTACT BLOCK — 'Get In Touch' / 'Drop Us a Line'. Background: Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9). Vertical padding: 80px top and bottom. Layout: asymmetric two-column grid on desktop. Left column (columns 1–7, 60% width): the primary contact form. Right column (columns 8–12, 40% width): stacked direct contact detail cards. EYEBROW: Fredoka One, 12px, 0.10em letter-spacing, all-caps, Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0), sitting above the headline. HEADLINE: Nunito 700, 38px, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), left-aligned above the form column. SUBHEADLINE: DM Sans 400, 16px, Deep Petal at 65% opacity, 12px below headline, left-aligned, max-width 420px. FORM (left column): The contact form sits on a Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) rounded card (24px border-radius, no drop shadow — flat and clean). Form fields include: Name (full width), Email (full width), Subject (full width, rendered as a friendly dropdown with options: Product Question / Wholesale / Press / Just Saying Hi / Other), Message (full-width textarea, 6 rows). All field labels in DM Sans 600, 14px, Deep Petal. Input borders: 2px solid Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) at rest, 2px solid Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) on focus. Input background: Bloom Milk. Input border-radius: 12px. Submit button: full-width, Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) background, Bloom Milk text, Nunito 700, 17px, 14px border-radius, 16px vertical padding, label 'Send Your Message →'. Button hover: Lumi Coral darkened 8%, slight scale(1.02) transform. Form card padding: 32px all sides. RIGHT COLUMN — Direct Contact Cards: Three stacked cards, each on Bloom Milk surface, 16px border-radius, 4px left border in Petal Mint (#A8E6CF), 20px padding, 16px vertical gap between cards. Card layout: item title (Nunito 600, 18px, Deep Petal) on top line; description (DM Sans 400, 15px, Deep Petal at 75% opacity) below; email address rendered in Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) as a tappable mailto link, DM Sans 500, 15px, with a subtle underline. The three cards cover: General Inquiries, Wholesale & Retail, Press & Partnerships. Right column is vertically top-aligned to the form headline, not centered. On mobile: form stacks above the three contact cards, full-width, with 32px gap between them.

FAQ — 'Quick Answers' / 'The Questions We Get Most'. Background: a full-width Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) section band. Vertical padding: 72px top and bottom. Layout: asymmetric. The section uses a two-column structure where the LEFT column (columns 1–3, roughly 22% width) holds a large structural typographic label and the RIGHT column (columns 4–12) holds the five accordion FAQ items. LEFT COLUMN TYPOGRAPHIC ACCENT: The eyebrow text 'Quick Answers' is set in Fredoka One, 13px, 0.10em letter-spacing, all-caps, Deep Petal (#2D3A35), at the top of the left column. Below it, the word 'FAQ' is set in Nunito 800, 80px, rotated −90 degrees (vertical text running bottom-to-top), in Deep Petal at 15% opacity — this acts as a large structural watermark label anchoring the left column. This oversized rotated type is a deliberate density contrast: the left column is typographically dramatic but visually quiet (low opacity), while the right column carries all the readable content. HEADLINE: Nunito 700, 36px, Deep Petal, left-aligned at the top of the right column, 0px top margin (aligned to the eyebrow label in the left column). No subheadline in this section. FAQ ACCORDION ITEMS (right column): Five items, each rendered as an accordion row on a Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) card surface, 16px border-radius, 20px vertical padding, 12px horizontal padding, 10px vertical gap between items. Question label: Nunito 600, 20px, Deep Petal. When collapsed, a Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) '+' icon sits at the far right of the row. When expanded, the answer text appears below the question in DM Sans 400, 16px, 1.65 line-height, Deep Petal at 75% opacity, with a 2px top border in Petal Mint separating question from answer. The first FAQ item is shown pre-expanded by default to signal interactivity. The expand icon rotates to '×' on open state (Aqua Bloom color). No CTAs in this section. On mobile: left column collapses — the rotated 'FAQ' watermark is hidden, the eyebrow label moves inline above the headline, and the accordion items go full-width.

FEATURE GRID — 'Stay Connected' / 'More Ways to Find Us'. Background: Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4). Vertical padding: 80px top and bottom. Layout: centered content column (max-width 1100px), with eyebrow and headline centered above the grid. EYEBROW: Fredoka One, 12px, 0.10em letter-spacing, all-caps, Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) on a Deep Petal (#2D3A35) pill badge (8px border-radius, 6px vertical / 14px horizontal padding) — this badge treatment makes the eyebrow feel like a playful sticker, consistent with the friendly-consumer-app visual cues. HEADLINE: Nunito 700, 38px, Deep Petal, centered, 16px below the eyebrow badge. SUBHEADLINE: DM Sans 400, 17px, Deep Petal at 65% opacity, centered, max-width 560px, 12px below headline. GRID: 2×2 card grid (2 columns, 2 rows) with 24px gap between all cards. Each card: Soft Cloud (#EDF6F9) background, 24px border-radius, 32px padding, no drop shadow. Card top: illustrated icon at 56px × 56px, left-aligned within the card, rendered with Aqua Bloom (#5BC8D0) strokes and Petal Mint (#A8E6CF) fill areas (from the four-icon set: camera for Instagram, play symbol for TikTok, envelope-with-star for Newsletter, speech bubble cluster for Community). Icon sits in a 72px × 72px Bloom Milk circle with a 2px Petal Mint border, giving it a soft badge frame. Below icon: card title in Nunito 600, 22px, Deep Petal, 16px below the icon frame. Below title: description in DM Sans 400, 15px, Deep Petal at 70% opacity, 1.55 line-height, 10px below title. For Instagram and TikTok cards: the handle '@lumiandbloom' is rendered as a small Fredoka One, 12px, all-caps, Aqua Bloom pill tag below the description. For Newsletter card: 'Monthly' frequency tag in the same Sunshine Butter pill style as the section eyebrow. For Community card: 'Online Community' tag in Petal Mint pill. Card hover state: a 3px Lumi Coral bottom border appears and the card lifts with a subtle box-shadow (0 4px 16px rgba(45,58,53,0.08)). On mobile: grid collapses to single column (1×4), cards full-width.

CTA CLOSE — 'While You're Here' / 'Explore the Products That Started It All'. Background: full-bleed Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) panel spanning the full viewport width. Vertical padding: 88px top and bottom. Layout: centered composition — this is one of the two cases where centering is aesthetically correct (terminal close panel, high-energy solid color block). All text and CTAs are horizontally centered within a max-width 720px content column. EYEBROW: Fredoka One, 12px, 0.10em letter-spacing, all-caps, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) at 80% opacity, centered, 0px top margin. HEADLINE: Nunito 800, 56px, −0.02em tracking, Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4), centered, 16px below eyebrow, two lines max. SUBHEADLINE: DM Sans 400, 18px, Bloom Milk at 85% opacity, centered, max-width 480px, 14px below headline, 1.6 line-height. STICKER ACCENT: A Sunshine Butter (#FFE566) sticker badge — a small irregular circle/blob shape, roughly 72px diameter — floats near the top-right of the headline text block (positioned absolutely, overlapping the headline's top-right corner by about 20px). Inside the sticker: Fredoka One, 10px, all-caps, Deep Petal text reading 'YOUR SKIN ✨'. This sticker is the playful illustrated-icon energy of the aesthetic applied as a typographic decoration, grounding the CTA panel in the brand's fun, human voice. CTA BUTTONS: Two buttons, horizontally centered, 20px gap between them. Primary: 'Shop the Collection' — Bloom Milk (#FFF8F4) background, Lumi Coral (#FF6F5E) text, Nunito 700, 17px, 14px border-radius, 16px vertical / 36px horizontal padding. Hover: slight scale(1.03), Bloom Milk background stays, subtle box-shadow. Secondary: 'Read Our Story' — transparent background, 2px solid Bloom Milk border, Bloom Milk text, same font and sizing as primary. Hover: Bloom Milk background at 15% opacity fills in. Buttons sit 28px below the subheadline. On mobile: buttons stack vertically (full-width, 12px gap), sticker badge repositions to float above the headline centered.
